description.value:
You drink a vial of metal flakes suspended in liquid to replenish your reserves; if the vial contains metal you can burn, you recover Investiture up to your maximum.

You remove the @UUID[Compendium.cosmere-rpg-mistborn-handbook.handbook.JournalEntry.b684FTgeTTE90HLs.JournalEntryPage.vyYzxzfhwORSeTLw#depleted]{Depleted} condition for any powers that use metals in the vial, and you become @UUID[Compendium.cosmere-rpg-mistborn-handbook.handbook.JournalEntry.b684FTgeTTE90HLs.JournalEntryPage.vyYzxzfhwORSeTLw#depleted]{Depleted} of any powers that use metals not in the vial.
